snippet.title: POP Float a-way - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description: POP Float a-way is a chaotic multiplayer party platformer for up to 8 players where you dash through obstacle-packed tracks by yelling into your mic, knock rivals off course, and try not to pop before you cross the finish line!
